info.name: Life Display API
info.description: API for ESP32 e-ink display - provides weather and time data for display rendering

request.description:
Returns complete weather data for display rendering:
- Current weather conditions (temp, feels like, humidity, wind, description, icon)
- Hourly forecast for next 12 hours
- Daily forecast for next 7 days

All temperatures in Fahrenheit, wind speeds in mph.

Response includes:
- viewType: 'weather'
- location: 'Plano, TX'
- timezone: 'America/Chicago'
- current: {temperature, feelsLike, humidity, windSpeed, description, icon}
- hourly: Array of 12 hourly forecasts
- daily: Array of 7 daily forecasts
- timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp

Returns current time and date information for display rendering:
- Personalized greeting based on time of day
- Formatted date and day of week
- Time in both 12-hour and 24-hour formats

Response includes:
- viewType: 'time'
- greeting: 'Good Morning' | 'Good Afternoon' | 'Good Evening'
- date: 'January 19, 2026'
- dayOfWeek: 'Sunday'
- time: '2:30 PM' (12-hour)
- time24h: '14:30' (24-hour)
- timezone: 'America/Chicago'
- timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp
